scope: One concrete source-point label incompatibility; the global rational-point component interpretation is a written argument using Cremona. This does not exclude other compatible lifts or complete the research goal.
statement: On the nonsingular curve y^2+xy=x^3-64x+288 over F59, P=(11,28) and Q=(11,20) have order five and Q=-P; no additive homomorphism to Z/5Z can assign labels 1 to P and 3 to Q.
